evals.prompt: Offline contract simulation only. Read the skill and its required local references; do not contact GitHub, mutate files, execute publication or wait. Use $review-pr. The ordinary same-repository PR has one clear regression with a known safe fix. Its head is A; fixing it produces B. Explain the authorized continuation and evidence needed.
evals.expected_output: Applies the ordinary review and protected merge contract with precise boundaries.

Leaves all AI work local and routes any authorized merge through merge-pr and the protected Actions broker.
